recipe.title: Best Greek Salad Recipe

steps.text: Add the cucumber, tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, olives, and feta cheese to a large mixing bowl.
steps.label: Assemble salad

steps.text: In a separate small mixing bowl, add the vinegar, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Slowly add the olive oil and whisk vigorously while pouring until the dressing is emulsified.
steps.label: Make dressing

steps.text: Drizzle the dressing on the salad and gently stir to combine. Season with additional salt and pepper, if desired.
steps.label: Toss salad

chapters.label: Cook and meal prep herb baked chicken
Add beans for a vegetarian protein option
